title: Parity: env var + CLI flag to relocate the sigstore and blob-info cache dirs
body:
Rootless podman writes two things under `$HOME/.local/share/containers` that sit outside `storage.conf`'s reach (different subsystem — containers/image):

1. Signature cache: `$HOME/.local/share/containers/sigstore` for unprivileged users (default documented in `containers/registries.d.5`). Observed live: blocking that path makes every pull fail at the "reading signatures" stage with `ENOTDIR`.
2. Blob-info cache (`pkg/blobinfocache`, sqlite backend; default `$XDG_DATA_HOME/containers/cache`, falling back to `~/.local/share/containers/cache`).

Source-checked, not just a help-text skim:
- Sigstore default (`containers/image` `docker/registries_d.go`): `defaultUserDockerDir = ".local/share/containers/sigstore"`, joined onto legacy `$HOME` via `filepath.Join(homedir.Get(), ...)` in `builtinDefaultLookasideStorageDir` — `XDG_DATA_HOME` is not consulted. No env var and no podman flag addresses it.
- Blob cache (`containers/image` `pkg/blobinfocache/default.go`): honors `XDG_DATA_HOME`, degrades to a memory-only cache on any failure (never fatal). The library field `SystemContext.BlobInfoCacheDir` exists and buildah exposes it as a (hidden) `--blob-info-cache-dir` flag — but podman hardcodes it to empty (`pkg/domain/infra/abi/artifact.go`) and exposes no flag (checked `podman --help` and `podman build --help`).

Use case: users who must keep that tree empty or redirected (sealed or redirected home directories; in my case a mode-0000 tripwire file that turns silent store repopulation into a loud failure instead of mystery state). Today the sigstore half breaks every pull with no recourse.

Notes: `registries.d` `lookaside` / `lookaside-staging` relocates signature *storage* per registry — related but not a global directory override, undiscoverable for this purpose, and it does not cover the blob cache.

Sibling parity status (what is already first-class, for calibration):

| Path | Env | CLI flag |
|---|---|---|
| graphroot / runroot / driver opts | `CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF` (the conf file itself is env-only) | `--root` / `--runroot` / `--storage-driver` / `--storage-opt`, `TMPDIR` / `--tmpdir` |
| registry auth | `REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE` | `--authfile` |
| registries.d location | — (`SystemContext.RegistriesDirPath` exists) | skopeo: `--registries.d`; podman: none |
| blob-info cache | `XDG_DATA_HOME` (generic default, honored) | none in podman (buildah: hidden `--blob-info-cache-dir`) |
| sigstore default | none — ignores `XDG_DATA_HOME` entirely | none |

The sigstore default is the only path with neither env, flag, XDG support, nor global config override (same `$HOME`-join pattern as the per-user registries.d itself); the blob cache has XDG but no dedicated knob.

Ask: env + CLI-flag parity in podman for both defaults (names up to maintainers), or documented XDG support for the sigstore default.
